versions.changelog:
Initial release of Unit Test Coverage Helper.

- Provides guidance and support for adding useful unit tests and improving test coverage in existing codebases.
- Includes a practical, local-hardware-friendly workflow with tailored outputs, reusable checklists, and verification steps.
- Designed for software maintainers, QA engineers, open-source contributors, and teams seeking confidence in code changes.
- Supports a broad set of validated user demands based on multi-source evidence.
- Triggers on keywords related to unit tests, test coverage, and quality assurance.
